newsitem.title: USA: Circuit City Jan comps off, CarMax sales up.
newsitem.headline: Circuit City Jan comps off, CarMax sales up.

text.p: Circuit City Stores Inc said on Thursday its total sales, including CarMax Group sales, rose seven percent in January to $630.2 million from $590.0 million in January 1997.
Comparable store sales for the Circuit City Group fell 11 percent, while the group's total sales rose four percent to $587.1 million from $567.3 million, the company said.
Total sales for CarMax rose 90 percent to $43.1 million from January 1996 sales of $22.7 million. Comparable same store sales for CarMax rose 33 percent in January, it said.

"As expected, January sales for the Circuit City Group reflect a continuation of weak industry trends," Richard Sharp, Circuit City's chairman said. "Despite this weakness, we continue to see good demand for major appliances, digital satellite systems and big-screen televisions."
Sharp said CarMax total sales growth reflected the opening of two superstores in the past year, the addition of new cars at one location and market share gains by existing stores.
